Independently decomposing into the base rectangle, side strips and four quarter-disks gives A and both unnormalized moments: the x moment of one translated quarter-disk is a²πt²/4+2at³/3+πt⁴/16. Normalization is MxMy/A⁴. The expansion of 4A′MxMy−A(MxMy)′ has no constant term or terms above degree seven and agrees with all seven frozen coefficients. The first is positive by π<4; for the others the rational shift π=157/50+u gives positive monomial coefficients, establishing the sign for every a,b,t>0, including unequal sides and no aspect-ratio restriction. The endpoint values follow from the constant and leading terms. The coefficients of t and t⁷ in the derivative numerator give the stated quadratic corrections after division by A⁵ and integration at the respective endpoints; they also show the linear corrections vanish.
